description: This is a Java test class for the CCServices component, testing interactions with the ClearCommerce payment gateway within the OFBiz framework. It includes setup for test data and methods for testing authorization, credit, subscription purchase, report querying, and placeholders for free and cancel subscription tests.

classes.name: CCServicesTest
classes.description: A JUnit test case class for testing ClearCommerce payment services within the OFBiz framework.

methods.name: testAuth
methods.description: Tests the authorization process with ClearCommerce.

methods.name: testCredit
methods.description: Tests the credit (deduction) process with ClearCommerce.

methods.name: testPurchaseSubscription
methods.description: Tests purchasing a subscription via ClearCommerce.

methods.name: testFreeSubscription
methods.description: Placeholder for testing free subscription, currently not implemented.

methods.name: testCancelSubscription
methods.description: Placeholder for testing subscription cancellation, currently not implemented.

methods.name: testCCReport
methods.description: Tests querying the transaction report from ClearCommerce.
